notes.title: Extended Edition Released, Updated Soundtrack, And Small Update To The Original
notes.notes:
Extended Edition Released
The extended edition of Her Lie I Tried To Believe has just been released on steam! If you’re interested, please take a moment to check it out. Here’s the list of things that have been added:

2 abrupt endings
2 small variations to the original ending
1 true ending
10+ new CGs
6 new locations
More than double the number of words (22k VS. 47k)
4 new original pieces of music
2 new characters
 
As a side note, at first I was planning to add nudity to the game since nudity fits with the game mature setting pretty well, in my opinion, but with steam vague guidelines on sexual content I realized the value it added just wasn’t worth it. Since Cassandra is younger in the first chapter (flashback), and steam is very strict toward what they consider ‘minors’ in visual novels, I didn’t want to take the chance to get the game banned (even though sex only occurs later in the game when Cassandra is obviously 21). So I just wanted to take a moment to apologize to those of you who might have expected nudity (or any other form of sexual content) in the extended edition.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1313810/Her_Lie_I_Tried_To_Believe__Extended_Edition/

Updated Soundtrack
Four pieces of music have been added to the original soundtrack, so if you don’t already own it, you might consider looking into it. I’m personally a real sucker for those new tracks.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/806630/Her_Lie_I_Tried_To_Believe__Soundtrack/

The soundtrack can also be bought in conjunction with the extended edition for 15% off.

Small Update To The Original Version
Lastly, I updated the original version with two-ish new CGs, and I also added a background for the club (which didn’t have a background until now). It’s really nothing much, but I might as well mention it while I’m at it.

I’m very thankful to everyone who’s been supporting me up until now. Obviously, I would have loved to release the extended edition for free, but unfortunately (or fortunately?) I need money to produce more projects. Hopefully, I will have the opportunity to release free projects in the not-so-distant future.

Anyway, I’m grateful, is what I wanna say.

Thank you.

notes.title: Update Ver 1.03 (Adding of a disclaimer, and removal of the “nudity” tag)
notes.notes:
Hi, this is another quick update about two things in particular.

First, we’ve added a disclaimer on both the store page, and inside the game. This is something that should have been there since the very beginning. This will (hopefully) help people decide if this game is made for them or not.

The second thing is the “nudity” tag. Lots of people were asking, and searching for nudity in the game, and were quite disappointed. This tag was an artifact of before we made changes with the in-game text. We also don’t think this tag is appropriate for this game (ever), and decided to remove it. We think the “sexual content” tag is more than enough to describe what’s going on inside our game. We’re sorry if this misled anyone into downloading, and playing it.

Lastly, I simply want to thank everyone who played. We’re reading your reviews and comments, and we’re very happy with how supportive most of you have been. As of right now, this experience has been quite positive.

So, for that, I thank you.

notes.title: Indefinite delay for the steam release
notes.notes: It seems that, even though our game has no sexual depiction, because of the text portion of the game is being considered as ‘porn’ from steam’s perspective, we won’t be able to release it on its platform unless we somehow censure it. I must admit I’m quite depressed, as this game is nowhere near what I would personally call of ‘pornographic’ nature.  Still, we can do nothing but comply and think of a way to change the game while still keeping the core of it intact. In the meantime, if you want to download the current version, you can find all the detail on our twitter account ( https://twitter.com/HGPurrroduction ).
